articles.title: The Global AI Race: Chips, Talent, and World Models
articles.description: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Alibaba's new AI chip, an accelerator to compete with Nvidia and underpinning a massive expansion of data center capacity in coming years. Plus, he speaks with Gagan Biyani, founder and CEO of the Horowitz Andreessen Academy, Silicon Valley's alternative college for the AI era. And, he sits down with AI pioneer Fei-Fei Li to talk about the AI safety debate, the race against China, and growing competition to build world models. (Source: Bloomberg)
